author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-RobustLocComBat: Location-only Robust ComBat Embedding + Residualized Balanced Graph
abstract: Embedding uses location-only robust ComBat (median/MAD shrink, no variance scaling) on normalized/log1p full genes (PCA64). Graph uses residualized PC50 (γ=0.74) with equal-quota balanced cosine kNN (k=48, binary). Goal: modest kBET/cell_cycle gains without harming label/PCR.
